thesis: The market is in a 0.95-confidence risk-off regime with VIX near its 1-year high, and long swing exposure is explicitly flagged as needing a defensive stance. PLMR is the opposite of a defensive entry. It closed on a 5.7% momentum spike with no stated cause, RSI is 70.7, and the close is 8.5% above SMA20. Consensus upside is only about 3%, so the 180 target depends on a measured-move extrapolation. The technical card itself says to skip if price gaps up without a pullback, and the pre-market quote of 163.99 is already above the 159.5-162.5 entry zone. A single index-wide liquidation day would take out the stop at 151.9, and as a P&C insurer a catastrophe-loss gap is always possible.
